turns.user: ok so a few things, I'm starving today so I think I need more carbs, what should I have before training tomorrow morning, and is it fine that I skipped the stretching at the end yesterday
turns.reply:
Carbs — a bowl of oats with a sliced banana, or two slices of toast with jam about 60 to 90 minutes before tomorrow's session. Carbs right before training restock your muscle glycogen so you have full strength on your heavy sets, and oats or toast digest easily enough to avoid any stomach heaviness while you lift.

Skipping stretching yesterday — totally fine. Post-workout stretching feels nice and can help you wind down, but it doesn't reduce muscle soreness or drive your strength progress. The work that actually grows muscle and builds strength is what you did during the session itself.

For today's hunger, pulling a bit more food into your meals — especially slow-digesting carbs like potatoes, oats, or rice — will help settle your appetite without knocking your targets off track. Did you want to add a pre-workout meal into your plan for tomorrow morning?
